unit: verified site and geometry status
collection_and_calculation: Resolve Arabic English aliases with independent existing maps and imagery; preserve candidate matches
limitations: Geocoded points not GPS; unresolved names cannot be routed

unit: open partial closed historical unknown
collection_and_calculation: Extract market-specific dated status and corroborate; flag older than 90 days
limitations: No source means unknown; no inference from mapped roof or lights

indicator: Observable baseline roof or structure coverage
unit: percent baseline structures observable
collection_and_calculation: Use suitable baseline inventory and image quality review; classify observable denominator
limitations: 10 m imagery not stall inspection; medium-resolution data alone usually unsuitable

unit: damaged observable structures divided by observable baseline structures
collection_and_calculation: Use existing damage vectors or licensed adequate-resolution pre/post imagery; independent desk review
limitations: Not hidden damage structural integrity safety or all stalls; do not extrapolate unobservable structures

indicator: Market and nearby facility footprint density
unit: m2 per hectare and documented asset counts
collection_and_calculation: Intersect de-duplicated buildings and facility types with declared footprint/neighborhood
limitations: Physical footprint not utilization function or operating status; POI completeness varies

unit: documented operating nonoperating or unknown for four categories
collection_and_calculation: Code current water sanitation/waste power-or-alternative and loading/storage evidence separately
limitations: Mapped pipes or facilities do not establish service reliability or quality

unit: documented capacity and status with units
collection_and_calculation: Extract existing facility records and current condition; retain unknown capacity
limitations: Roofed buildings not proof of cold chain or usable capacity

unit: minutes
collection_and_calculation: OD matrix from fixed 5 km terrestrial neighborhood to verified entrances; named speed/network scenario
limitations: Modeled physical access not safe affordable or inclusive travel; no denominator means missing

unit: fraction neighborhood residents with feasible path
collection_and_calculation: Use same origins as I08; keep disconnected origins and snap failures distinct
limitations: Network omissions can cause false disconnection; service envelopes can cross barriers

unit: people by low central high scenario
collection_and_calculation: Mass-preserving allocation to harmonized totals; nearest eligible market within 60 minutes; count once
limitations: Not actual customers purchasers footfall or beneficiaries; selected cohort may omit competing markets

unit: people and km2 at 15 30 60 minutes
collection_and_calculation: Report each market catchment and union separately; retain population scenario
limitations: Market totals overlap and cannot be summed; no proof of market preference

unit: SDG per standard unit and percent change
collection_and_calculation: Align item grade unit retail/wholesale and period; compute nominal matched changes
limitations: National or regional prices not market observations; official and parallel FX not interchangeable

unit: percent available plus observation completeness
collection_and_calculation: Predeclare eligible basket; available over observed items; publish observed over total; require 80 percent completeness for score
limitations: Price presence is not stock inventory; missing price is not stockout; baskets differ by type

unit: standard deviation of monthly log price changes
collection_and_calculation: Use same unit/item/market and at least 12 consecutive monthly prices producing 11 valid changes
limitations: Nominal inflation currency and seasonal shocks confound; insufficient series not zero volatility

unit: available eligible food groups and completeness
collection_and_calculation: Code documented availability of predefined nutritious groups suitable to food markets
limitations: No food-safety micronutrient or affordability inference from group presence; specialized markets differ

indicator: Reported origins hubs and supply links
unit: directed commodity links with optional reported quantity
collection_and_calculation: Extract dated source-destination-commodity-season links with reported status; map observed versus modeled separately
substitute_for_primary: Supply chain mapping and trader sourcing
limitations: Historic route or a reference citation not proof current flow; no invented tonnage

unit: detour ratio and disconnected origins under closure
collection_and_calculation: Remove named edges in a scenario and compare shortest feasible routes; identify single points of failure
limitations: Modeled alternative not actual passage or freight cost; bridge status needs dated evidence

unit: count edge-disjoint paths and alternative-route share
collection_and_calculation: Use same mode-specific fixed graph and documented restrictions; test alternatives
limitations: Road paths not independent suppliers; may share insecurity or flood exposure

unit: recency-weighted event count plus precision exclusions
collection_and_calculation: Unique qualifying violent events within 5 km over 180 days; half-life 90 days; 1/10 km and 90/365-day sensitivity
limitations: Reporting gaps precision and lag; no records does not establish safety; datasets not summed

unit: dated closure looting blockade or interruption record
collection_and_calculation: Extract market/corridor-specific reported disruptions with dates corroboration and lineage
limitations: Unsafe to publish sensitive live details; source mentions may duplicate one event
mcda_use: Context and safeguards not automatic gate pass

indicator: Market road and population flood exposure
unit: percent footprint km road and potential residents exposed
collection_and_calculation: Intersect specific return-period depth maps and separate observed flood extents with assets; state depth threshold
limitations: Global river models omit local drainage; observed event not hazard probability; nodata not dry
mcda_use: R environmental feasibility plus separate maps

unit: mm and percent where baseline nonzero
collection_and_calculation: Consistent CHIRPS v2 monthly series against 1991-2020 climatology; local and upstream basin analysis
limitations: 0.05 degree not plot drainage; preliminary products and near-zero denominators need care

indicator: Surface heat and regional thermal context
unit: degrees C with product and observation time
collection_and_calculation: Apply Landsat temperature scaling and quality masks; separate ERA5 air-temperature context
limitations: Surface temperature not measured air temperature or WBGT; clear-sky bias and coarse thermal support

unit: NDVI and matched-season anomaly
collection_and_calculation: Cloud-masked same-season NDVI with land-cover and phenology interpretation in supplier areas
limitations: Vegetation not crop yield trader income market functionality or food security

indicator: Water context and documented utility access
unit: surface-water occurrence plus dated service status
collection_and_calculation: Keep historical water occurrence separate from existing documented operational supply
limitations: Surface water not potable supply groundwater or functioning water point

unit: radiance change valid area and observation count
collection_and_calculation: Quality-controlled matched-month neighborhood composites; baseline noise check; cross-sensor continuity audit
limitations: Not GDP sales jobs footfall or isolated market signal; fires power restoration and sensors confound

unit: distinct POIs by type and documented status
collection_and_calculation: Classify de-duplicated POIs within declared area and audit completeness/age
limitations: Informal traders underrepresented; edits not new businesses; mapped presence not operating firms

unit: neighborhood district locality metropolitan regional
collection_and_calculation: Extract market role and geographic reach with dates; distinguish historical/current scenario
limitations: Specialization or size alone not proof of hierarchy or turnover

unit: 0 to 1 under declared graph convention
collection_and_calculation: Compute on fixed extent/mode/directed graph; document endpoint component and normalization choices
limitations: Graph-scale dependent; not observed trade; source omissions may distort centrality

indicator: Financial presence operation products and constraints
unit: documented services terms and status
collection_and_calculation: Extract branches/agents within 5 km plus operation evidence and product dates; keep unknowns
limitations: Branch location not liquidity affordability equal access borrowing or insurance; terms not uptake

indicator: Mobile coverage and documented digital-service continuity
unit: coverage class plus outage/service record
collection_and_calculation: Use licensed coverage models and existing dated outage/payment reports separately
limitations: Coverage not reliable internet adoption e-commerce sales or women's digital access

indicator: Existing evidence on women youth and disability barriers
unit: dated qualitative constraints or sourced disaggregated shares
collection_and_calculation: Extract applicable existing disaggregation with definitions denominator and age threshold; use unknown otherwise
limitations: Population structure cannot estimate women/youth traders or equal access; no invented participation shares

unit: 0 25 50 75 100 or unknown
collection_and_calculation: Review existing land allocation consent permits and disputes against declared rubric
limitations: Vacant appearance not ownership consent or dispute-free tenure; historical permission may expire
mcda_use: R land permission and tenure gate

indicator: Engineering preparation and bounded repair pathway
unit: 0 25 50 75 100 or unknown
collection_and_calculation: Review existing qualified condition records designs options and dated cost evidence
limitations: Remote visible condition not structural certification bill of quantities or current material rates
mcda_use: R engineering preparation and technical gate

unit: 0 25 50 75 100 or unknown
collection_and_calculation: Review existing owner agreement maintenance plan operating costs service model and financing
limitations: No assumed revenue from population size; no owner/funding record means unknown

unit: 0 25 50 75 100 or unknown
collection_and_calculation: Combine documented screening and approvals with flood drainage waste inclusion displacement and mitigation options
limitations: Hazard overlap alone not permit or mitigation approval; no record means unknown
mcda_use: R environmental social feasibility and gate

unit: dated status sequence and recovery interval
collection_and_calculation: Track repeated documented status/physical/service signals; bracket between last disrupted and first recovered observations
limitations: Single image cannot show recovery time; light restoration not income recovery; no causal attribution

unit: distinct evidenced supply origins or supplier categories
collection_and_calculation: Extract documented contemporary supplier diversity by commodity and season
limitations: Route alternatives not independent suppliers; missing counts remain unknown

indicator: Affordability or terms of trade if denominators exist
unit: basket cost over comparable wage or income
collection_and_calculation: Match dated basket and documented income/wage/transfer denominator with relevant population
limitations: Macro wage not all households; no income denominator means affordability unknown

indicator: Existing trader employment capital and participation records
unit: sourced counts shares or qualitative constraints
collection_and_calculation: Use already existing records only; retain definition period denominator and coverage
substitute_for_primary: Trader numbers working capital employment modules
limitations: Building counts lights and population cannot yield trader jobs profits or capital loss; no new survey

indicator: Food quality protection and safe access evidence
unit: documented findings or unknown
collection_and_calculation: Extract applicable existing food-safety protection and access assessments with sensitivity review
limitations: Imagery does not certify hygiene safety discrimination or absence of exploitation; unknown is not good

unit: number of four roles with positive evidence
collection_and_calculation: Code retail wholesale producer aggregation onward distribution independently; 25 points each with eligible evidence
limitations: Commodity count not function diversity; absent documentation is unknown rather than no role
